title: 2 · Organization Context Lake
purpose: Show governed read, slow learning, and separately authorized effect paths: raw evidence is append-only, materialized views are rebuildable, ContextPacket returns only to agent reasoning, and every real-world effect passes a capability broker and executor.
caption: A Context Lake compiles governed experience; it does not dump history into a prompt.

forbidden_edges.reason: ContextPacket is read context and never effect authority
read context cannot originate an effect authorization request
a context packet cannot request or commit an effect
the read compiler cannot originate an action
the read compiler cannot bypass the broker or enter effect execution
effect re-authorization belongs at the capability path, not at packet output
raw evidence must pass governed views and context compilation
raw evidence never flows directly into an agent prompt
raw evidence cannot bypass foundry, independent eval, promotion, and canary
the component producing a candidate cannot skip independent verification
verified candidates still require promotion scope and canary
promotion cannot write directly to prompt output
rollback selects a known-good derived version and never rewrites raw evidence
queries cannot bypass authorization and Context Compiler routing
serving views cannot bypass Context Compiler and Context Gateway
vertical agents return proposed actions to the Edge Coding Agent
all effects require a fresh broker authorization
the broker grants capability but the executor owns effect commit
new observations return to typed traces, never promoted memory
effect results must enter append-only traces before learning

layout_notes: Place Edge Interaction on the far left, Learning across the upper middle, Governance as a horizontal spine, Serving across the lower middle, and Effects on the far right.
Draw CL-04 and CL-13 as visibly separated read-request and trace-submission lanes into distinct ports of Context Gateway.
Route CL-05 with CL-06, CL-20 with CL-21, and CL-31 with CL-32 as separated request and decision lanes with no shared trunk.
Route CL-08 retrieval request and CL-09 record response in separated parallel lanes between Context Compiler and Governed Materialized Views + Index.
Route CL-34 effect call and CL-35 result response in separated lanes across the trust boundary.
Return CL-11 and CL-12 to the Edge Coding Agent through a blue outer corridor that never touches the effect path.
Place Offline Eval, Promotion Gate, Canary, and Rollback as explicit consecutive gates above the governed views.
Place Revocation Event and Lineage-Aware Recompute below the governance spine with clear targets at views, compiler, and broker.
Draw the trust boundary as containment around Capability Broker and Effect Executor; the boundary itself is never an arrow endpoint.
